features.description: Stable key/type identity is defined for declarative reconciliation
Dynamic-layer reactive binding, computed values and batch notification contract; static DSL remains dependency-free
Retained mount/update/detach lifecycle plus optional dynamic component lifecycle; no keep-alive before explicit contract
Identity/lifecycle/state ownership contracts have tests before implementation
UIDescription/UIReconciler deleted; static DSL materializes live widgets
TextField or ScrollViewport retains and clears transient state correctly
Events write Reactive/model; bound widgets invalidate without a render-function controller
Per-control Slate/EUI-NEO style typed builder and static children composition
UIDocument instantiate-once and list-widget keyed rows; no app-level render-function VDOM
Typed builder materializes retained WidgetTree; UIDescription path removed
List widgets own keyed row reuse; page-level Description reorder is removed
DSL can author appearance without UITheme
DSL builders bind Reactive<T> values so value changes invalidate the widget without re-running render or reconcile
Static typed builder materializes a live WidgetTree without UIDescription, apply, or UIRenderController
UIReconciler removed; known structure uses attach/detach/visibility, variable lists use list widgets
UIDescription removed; not kept as an experiment
UIScreen unmount detaches subtree; deferred until game UI surfaces, not Gallery/Editor
Standalone GUI app renders WidgetTree to windowed surface
Headless host builds immutable snapshot
GameUIHost mounts scene UI and builds runtime snapshot
Editor panel renders WidgetTree without ImGui
Controls render with deterministic fallback without theme
Authored color changes invalidate paint cache
Authored brush changes invalidate paint and retain resources
NinePatch preserves corners and stretches edges/center
Border brush renders frame without center
Rounded rectangle primitive exists
Common visual state contract
Editor core controls have complete appearance and states
Inline document stores authored visual properties with migration
Inline document renders without UITheme
Windowed/offscreen/headless parity
GUI and GPU resources teardown safely
Editor has no ImGui dependency
